findings.claim: 零售 takaful 市佔由 2022 年 0.8% 升至 2026 年 6 月底約 9%（ISM 資料），份額上升；為零售分項，非整體家庭 takaful 份額
findings.excerpt: The strategy is gaining traction, as Takaful Malaysia's retail market share has risen sharply from just 0.8% in 2022 to about 9% as at end-June this year.

findings.claim: 2026 年未搜到新進入者或替代供應商搶單的報導；分析師稱 takaful 業者家數少，定期保費領域潛力大
findings.excerpt: MBSB Research said given the low number of takaful players in the market, the regular-premium space holds plenty of potential.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 整體家庭 takaful 份額變化、新進入者（BNM 新牌照）均未查到；搜尋僅兩次。
